purpose: Guarded native source geometry only; not stock PDF financial activation
input: Owned original ArrayBuffer; snapshot before first await; same eight MiB limit
coordinates: PDF units relative to visible-page lower-left; original page view retained
text: Nonblank native items; whitespace items leave gaps in physical item indices. Keep glyphText and extractionText when present. No table, money, quantity, dimension or scope inference.
sharedGuards: native PDF.js and audited Unicode/font integrity
page count, permissions, layers, widgets, rotation and clipping
paint visibility, occlusion, contrast, numeric glyph binding and image diagnosis
existing text, character, row and layout-work limits
readingIssues: Retain overlap and page-edge warnings with page, line and reasons; never convert these to a financial approval. Later domain reader must resolve or block them under its explicit isolation contract.
failure: No source result until all pages have passed; restore guards and destroy the document on success, failure or thrown progress callback.

budget.frozenSources: All nineteen PDFs and eighty-one v2 sealed files, unchanged

excluded: inventory PDF accounting records, replay, decisions and Excel
OCR, images, Arabic inventory PDF family, models or cloud fallback
new file/page limits, enterprise capacity or blind holdout claims
